g.text: Two Knowledge Graph Models · Same Semantic Engineering Methodology
The graph model is shaped by the use case. Both are governed by named custodians and validated by agents.
Four-layer ontology of the live system · continuously curated by four custodians
User Experience · API Gateway · Services · Agents · Event Queue · Data Lake · Observability · Infrastructure
Moving target. Continuously curated through sprints.
Updated on every PR merge. Lifetime: years of continuous operation.
AGENTS TRAVERSE THE FOUR LAYERS FOR EACH PR
Source-state, Target-state, and speciﬁcation format · governed by the same four custodians
deﬁned by custodians from a target blueprint
speciﬁcation-as-code that bridges Source-state and Target-state
extractable to: BRD · BDD function tests · end-to-end test scripts · code chatbot
each module: Retain · Modify · Replace · Retire
Bounded delivery target, long-term knowledge investment.
Custodians own the ontologies continuously, at a lower cadence than the live SDLC graph.
Lifetime: persists from modernization through ongoing operation of the modern system.
AGENTS GENERATE AND VALIDATE AGAINST BOTH CONTRACTS
